# Mani Sai Teja Bejjala - Portfolio

> Robotics & Systems Engineer | ECE Student @ IIIT Sri City | Seeking Summer 2027 Internships

## About
Mani Sai Teja Bejjala is a 3rd-year Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) student at IIIT Sri City specializing in robotics, embedded systems, autonomous control, and sensor fusion. Actively seeking technical internships for Summer 2027.

## Key Projects & Areas
- **Robotics & Control**: ROS2/ROS robotic simulations, kinematic modeling, and PID motor control.
- **Embedded Systems**: Real-time firmware, peripheral drivers (I2C/SPI/UART), and microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, Arduino).
- **Edge AI & Computer Vision**: OpenCV vision pipelines, on-device OCR zoning, and sensor fusion (IMU, LiDAR).
- **High-Performance Systems & Physics**: Space debris orbital propagation models (Python/Julia) and distributed L7 gateways (Go).

## Core Skills & Technologies
- **Robotics & Hardware**: ROS, Gazebo, OpenCV, STM32, ESP32, Arduino, FreeRTOS, Raspberry Pi
- **Languages**: C++, C, Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript
- **Systems & Tools**: Linux, Git, Docker, Prometheus, Bun, Vite
